title: Every training example says where its reasoning came from: Home turns joined to their thinking, the rules' own reasons, and the gap counted
request: The owner, 2026-10-28 night: make sure all previous data has thinking and reasoning parts; every agent and every kind of help.
spec: Part C (free parts) of the approved plan: join Home turns to their saved thinking; give rule-written turns the rules' stated reason; a lost note where neither exists, dated by the turn's own time; file conversations by their kind of help; count reasoning by source beside every set; a store check; Claude's recorded thinking as a silver set; the paid replay planned only.
plan: Measure where reasoning could come from (chat.agent events, draft messages, questions' why).
Label every answer turn with one source, never mixed, and count them per set.
Review adversarially; move what the review found unsafe (the paid replay) into its own package.

decisions.decision: A question counts as the rules' only when no model ran the conversation and no critic or advisor asked it.
decisions.why: The model's ask_user tool writes the same kind of question with its own why; crediting it to the rules would mislabel a model's words.

decisions.decision: The paid replay waits for its own package.
decisions.why: The shaped records have their tables removed, so a replay would not re-send the original inputs; it also lost the original's split and consent, and needs a replayed source in the contract.

decisions.decision: Claude's whole exchanges with recorded thinking form a silver reasoning set, apart, at half weight.
decisions.why: The owner's decision of 2026-10-25: a provider's outputs train too, silver and apart; the clean reasoning set had 0 rows because every exchange was Claude's.

change: store/sets/llm.py (home_thinking, home_turn, from_draft by track stage, FIX_AT dating, every purpose in STAGES, the silver reasoning set); store/sets/__init__.py (REASONING.json per set); store/catalog.py (reasoning counts); store/check.py (two checks on the newest versions); store/backfill.py and the CLI backfill (the plan only).

findings.defect: No Home turn carried reasoning in model 4's set.
findings.scenario: 11,264 assistant turns, 0 with reasoning; the reasoning-only set had 0 rows.
findings.cause: from_draft labelled every agent turn 'its thinking is in its model exchange' and never joined it; Claude's exchanges were excluded from the clean reasoning set.
findings.fix: Turns are joined through the chat.agent event to their exchange's thinking; rule-written turns get the rules' reason; Claude's recorded thinking forms a silver set.

findings.defect: A new positional argument broke two store commands.
findings.scenario: store accept fx123 put the id in the new argument and refused.
findings.cause: The optional positional was declared before the existing one.

findings.defect: A replay could carry a sealed input into train.
findings.scenario: 38 of the planned replays had sealed originals; their replays would be split anew.
findings.cause: The replay lost the original's split.
findings.fix: The replay is held back; the plan never counts a sealed original.

findings.defect: A replay would not re-send the original inputs.
findings.scenario: 223 of 341 planned calls had printed tables removed by the shaper.
findings.cause: The replay read the shaped record.
findings.fix: The plan skips any call whose inputs the shaper changed: 88 remain.

findings.defect: A model's question was credited to the rules.
findings.scenario: 734 questions in drafts run by a model would have read 'Home's rules asked for ...'.
findings.fix: Only questions with no source in a conversation no model ran.

findings.defect: The lost note was dated by the store's capture time.
findings.scenario: Old turns captured later would read 'not kept'; new ones 'lost'.
findings.cause: record.at is when the store kept the draft.
findings.fix: Each message's own time, else the draft's own dates, against the fix's commit time.

findings.defect: The new store check could never pass.
findings.scenario: Older set versions are never rewritten, so they would never have REASONING.json.
findings.fix: Only the newest version of each set.

measurements.name: Where a Home turn's reasoning can come from (drafts on this machine)
measurements.result: 13,771 agent messages in drafts: 6,504 questions carry the rules' why, about 4,050 data summaries and recaps were written by code, 332 were written by a model, the rest have no recorded author; only 39 of 13,159 chat events link a turn to its model call, and none of those had thinking text
limits: the thinking of the past was mostly never saved; this labels it honestly rather than recovering it

outcome: Every answer turn in the training sets now has its reasoning with its source, or a note saying why not; the catalog shows the gap per set.
lessons: A reasoning label must say who reasoned: the rules, the model, or nobody known; the same message kind can come from both.
risks: Most past Home turns carry the rules' stated reason or a lost note, not a model's thinking; the paid replay and the teacher are the next package.
